idea.pitch: Farmers around Nashik can list vegetables and grapes for restaurants and small grocery shops to browse and order in bulk. Buyers can pay online, and local transport partners deliver orders with a simple delivery status. Joining, browsing and listing produce are free; farmers pay about 4% commission per sale, and buyers pay the delivery fee.
